reason: I've never heard of TODO, and I'm not putting a tracker on my daughter from a brand with no track record, especially when a lost child is the one thing I can't afford to get wrong. Also, $249 plus $20 a month on top of what we already pay for therapy is a hard sell on a $58,000 salary.
objection: Will this company still exist, and will the device and the data plan work when it counts, in the middle of the night, when she has wandered off?
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews or a caregiver I know personally who has used it for months without a failure, plus a trial period where I can return it for a full refund.
